forbidden.name: web-only-uses-public-service-contract
forbidden.comment: Web production code may use the exported Main app type, never service implementation files.

forbidden.name: main-app-contract-is-types-only-in-web
forbidden.comment: The exported Main app contract is an Eden type edge, not a browser runtime dependency.

forbidden.name: accounts-reaches-account-over-http
forbidden.comment: The Accounts site talks to the Account service only through its HTTP API and proxy.

forbidden.name: browser-code-has-no-server-dependencies
forbidden.comment: Shared UI and browser feature modules cannot depend on server-only builtins or packages.

forbidden.name: main-modules-do-not-import-entrypoints
forbidden.comment: Business modules receive dependencies from composition code instead of importing the app or boot process.

forbidden.name: infrastructure-does-not-import-business-modules
forbidden.comment: Main infrastructure stays below business modules in the dependency graph.

forbidden.name: service-source-does-not-import-web
forbidden.comment: Backend and model production code may not depend on the web or Accounts applications.

forbidden.name: shared-packages-do-not-import-executables
forbidden.comment: Reusable package source depends on contracts, never an application or service implementation.

forbidden.name: authored-model-does-not-import-consumers
forbidden.comment: The authored model and compiler cannot depend on generated bindings or runtime consumers.
